# Slot: transient_time 


_Length of the leading settling window, prepended to `duration`. It marks part of ONE integration — never a separate simulation: the backend integrates `transient_time + duration` in a single scan and the marked head is cut where the run is consumed (observations, analyses, plots, saved data), so the settle is in-band for any observation kernel that needs warm-up. Time is measured from the START of the measured window: the settle carries non-positive timestamps and ends at 0, the measured window opens one step later, and a declared event `t0` is relative to measurement, never to the scan. A settle that a fit reuses across many candidate evaluations is NOT this slot — that is a seed, declared as `initial_state.method: time_integration` with its own `duration`._
